definition: a building with a bar where people drink
description: A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.
